map.清水用铸铁/不锈钢，酸碱用工程塑料或衬氟，油类用铸钢: Fresh water uses cast iron / stainless steel; acid/alkali use engineering plastic or PTFE-lined; oil uses cast steel.

map.工业输运选型：输入流量、扬程、介质密度与效率，算轴功率并据介质选泵型: Industrial transport selection: enter flow, head, medium density, and efficiency to compute shaft power and pick pump type by medium.

map.算法：轴功率 P = ρgQH/(3600×1000×η)（kW，g=9.8）；: Algorithm: shaft power P = ρgQH/(3600×1000×η) (kW, g=9.8); motor = shaft × 1.1, rounded up to the standard series (0.75/1.1/1.5/2.2/…/315 kW); pump type and material by medium (water / oil / acid / slurry).
map.例：清水 Q=50m³/h、H=30m、ρ=1000、η=0.75 → 轴功率: Example: fresh water Q=50 m³/h, H=30 m, ρ=1000, η=0.75 → shaft 5.44 kW, motor 5.99 → 7.5 kW standard motor; H<60 m with good suction, choose a single-stage centrifugal / inline pump (cast iron or stainless). If oil medium, choose a positive-displacement pump and consider viscosity.
map.为什么配电机比轴功率大？: Why is the motor larger than the shaft power?
It includes transmission, overload, and starting margins; the standard motor series is discrete, so round up to the nearest rating (e.g. 5.99→7.5 kW).
